Root cause verified on current main: resolveSettledTurnFinalizationRequest returns null when settledTurnFinalizationAvailable=false; prepareTerminalWithSettledTurnFinalization immediately returns finalizationOutcome not-attempted before its existing deterministic fallback/persistence path. Existing settled-turn-finalization.unavailable.test.ts only covers finalizeSettledTurn present-but-throwing, not truly undefined.

Direct Codex dependency proof already inspected in sibling ../codex:
- codex-rs/app-server-protocol/src/protocol/v2/turn.rs: TurnCompletedNotification owns a Turn that can carry no final assistant item.
- codex-rs/app-server/src/bespoke_event_handling.rs: emit_turn_completed_with_status emits an empty items list/NotLoaded when last_agent_message is absent, while completed tools arrive separately through ItemCompleted.
Therefore completed side effects must not replay; OpenClaw must end required visible turns with one honest deterministic terminal fallback.

Plan and implement under Repair Doctrine:
1. Write plan.md and goal.json with exact gates.
2. Strict RED first: boundary regression where harness.finalizeSettledTurn is truly undefined after completed potentially side-effecting tool work. Prove one fallback delivered and persisted, no tool/model replay, no duplicate side effects, original attempt unchanged. Also cover failed-tool failure honesty and silentExpected behavior.
3. Minimal canonical production fix reusing existing fallback builder, transcript persistence, suppression metadata and idempotency. No config, retry, or parallel fallback.
4. Inspect callers, siblings and history. Production LOC net-neutral if possible.
5. Run focused tests plus required format/lint/typecheck/build and relevant broad tests. Use isolated dev/mock boundary; never touch operator gateway/state.
6. Reviewer starts only after pre-review gates are green and remains read-only. Review exact HEAD, Codex contract, sibling paths and production-vs-test LOC.
7. Iterate until advance or genuine blocker.
8. Do not push or create PR; root owner publishes after independent verification.

When planning is complete, emit the exact spawn_subagents control block.
